title: First completed root-line transport
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l and a scheme isomorphism g:X→Y. Use the root, coefficient and module constructions of [def-pur-twist-sheaves, def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data, lem-pur-roots-of-unity-inverse-image-iso]. Let r:g⁻¹ Z_l(1)_Y→Z_l(1)_X be the canonical inverse-limit comparison: limit.post followed by the limit of the prescribed finite-root isomorphisms. There exists an isomorphism e:F_g O_E(1)_Y≅O_E(1)_X of completed-coefficient modules. For every site object V, every completed coefficient section a over V and every root-limit section x over V, e(eta(a·(1 tensor x)))=c_g(a)·(1 tensor r(eta(x))). Here F_g and eta are the coefficient-identified module pullback and its unit. There is no assertion about higher or signed powers, or uniqueness, and no assumption that l is invertible on X.

proof.text: The finite root comparisons commute with transitions, and inverse image at an isomorphism preserves the inverse limit. Their limit r is an isomorphism and is semilinear for the completed Z_l coefficient comparison, as checked after every finite projection. Extend through the constant O_E scalar tensor. The completed coefficient comparison respects both scalar inclusions of the recorded coefficient pushout, hence the induced arrow is linear for the completed action. It takes a times (1 tensor x) to c(a) times (1 tensor r(eta(x))). The inverse construction with the inverse scheme isomorphism gives inverse composites by scalar tensor generation and sheafification. This uses no invertibility of l and also works on the empty scheme.

mathlib_searches.query: Inverse image along an isomorphism of ringed sites extends the canonical inverse limit of roots of unity to integral and finite coefficient Tate lines
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits, including Scheme.inv_app and stalk isomorphism lemmas; none states the root-limit coefficient comparison. A second query on maps from sheafified tensor powers returns SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections and sheafification maps, which do not establish generation by these root tensors.

TensorProduct.ext in Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.TensorProduct.Basic supplies ordinary tensor extensionality. It does not state sheafified root-power generation or normalized inverse-image maps. Earlier SheafOfModules, _ ≅ _ query returned general module isomorphisms only.

msearch Mathlib grep: zero hits. Local library search finds the normalized signed-line API and integral tensor transport, but they require local freeness or invertibility of l; the present original theorem assumes only that g is an isomorphism. The canonical ordinary tensor pullback theorem is already proved and is used for power induction. Blueprint searches for root tensor, generator-normalized, internal Hom comparison and 03EL found no identical node.

theorem frobeniusIntegralRootTransport
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    (r : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage g AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
      (purTwistZlOne Y l) ⟶ purTwistZlOne X l)
    (hr : r = limit.post (proEtaleRootsOfUnityTower Y l Fact.out)
        (proEtaleSheafInverseImage g AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ≫
      lim.map (((proEtaleRootsOfUnityInverseImageIso g).2.1 l Fact.out).choose)) :
    ∃ e : (proEtaleRingModulePullback g (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E Y)
        (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X) ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).pull
          g)).obj (purTwistIntegralModule Y l E) ≅ (purTwistIntegralModule X l E),
      ∀ (V : Y.ProEt) (a : (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted l E Y).obj.obj (op V))
        (x : (purTwistZlOne Y l).obj.obj (op V)),
        e.hom.val.app (op ((proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V))
          (((proEtaleRingModuleAdjunction g (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E Y)
            (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X) ((PurCompactSupport.completed l
              E).pull g)).unit.app (purTwistIntegralModule Y l E)).val.app (op V)
            (@SMul.smul _ _ (purTwistIntegralAction Y l E (op V)).toSMul a
              (purTwistIntegralTensor Y l E (op V) 1 x))) =
      @SMul.smul _ _
        (purTwistIntegralAction X l E (op ((proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V))).toSMul
        ((sfCompletedCoefficientMap l E g).hom.app (op V) a)
        (purTwistIntegralTensor X l E (op ((proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V)) 1
          (r.hom.app (op ((proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V))
          (((proEtaleSheafAdjunction g AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).unit.app
            (purTwistZlOne Y l)).hom.app (op V) x)))
